apps.name: Rcode
apps.description:
Rcode is the ultimate creative sanctuary for code artists. Meticulously designed for the Relay ecosystem, it bridges the gap between desktop precision and mobile freedom.

Crafted for Excellence:
- Refined Workspace: An elegant, distraction-free environment that responds to your touch with buttery-smooth precision.
- Command Center: A fully-integrated professional terminal, putting the power of a desktop workstation in the palm of your hand.
- Deep Synergy: Built-in awareness of your projects, offering seamless navigation and real-time state management.
- Visual Perfection: A stunning Apple-inspired aesthetic featuring sophisticated glassmorphism and world-class typography.
- Unbound Creativity: Fully offline architecture ensures your best ideas are captured anywhere, at any time.

Elevate your craftsmanship with Rcode—the premier professional workspace for the modern creator.
apps.author: dotrly
apps.whatsNew: Initial professional release of Rcode for Relay. Introducing full CodeMirror 6 support, terminal integration, and premium UI.
